name: poly-world
description: A floating low-poly island behind the chat in the Claude Desktop and mobile apps. Its sky follows the time of day, and a matching color set tints the app.

enabled.title: Show the island
enabled.description: Off removes the scene and the colors. Also /world on|off.

colors.title: App colors
colors.description: Tint the Desktop app to match the island. Also /world colors on|off.

language.title: Language / Sprache
language.description: Language of the texts. en: English, de: Deutsch. Also /world language.
